nodes.text: The oxidizer line shows a tiny pressure drop. A full leak test takes a day.

That frosty line you wiped clean now shows a tiny pressure drop. A full leak test takes a day.

nodes.fact: Artemis I's first launch tries in 2022 were called off for a hydrogen leak. Tiny leaks delay big rockets.

nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: Good call! The test found a hairline crack in a valve seal.

variants.text: Good call! The test found a cracked valve seal, and we packed spares.

nodes.fact: Engineers sniff out leaks with helium gas. Its atoms are so tiny they escape through hairline cracks.

nodes.speaker: eng
nodes.text: There's no spare seal in the hold! Borrow one from a cargo-bay panel, or patch the old one?
nodes.fact: Nobody can pop to a shop in space, so crews repair things with the parts they brought along.
